a: Stale-replay check for `kit:setLayer` ignores the layer floor, so a replay after an untracked reparent can leave a child on a layer below its parent
b: A replayed `kit:setLayer` is never skipped for breaking the layer floor, so undo/redo after an untracked reparent puts a child below its parent's layer
`Scene.childrenOf`'s doc says a mark has no children, but marks can hold children and `childrenOf` returns them
`foldable` checks a version 1–2 save after its poses were already localized, so NaN poses can get past the guard it exists for
